# Zizi Solutions

> Zizi Solutions is a technology studio offering website development & SEO, business automation & AI integration, and data dashboards & reporting for small and medium businesses. It serves clients locally and globally.

## Business and contact
- [Home](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/): Business overview and services.
- [About](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/about): Founder Akhona Mdluli, mission, and operating hours.
- [Contact](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/contact): Project enquiries; admin@zizisolutions.co.za; +27 78 189 7780.

## Services
- [Website development & SEO](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/services/web-design-dev): Business websites, online stores, booking forms, and search visibility.
- [Business automation & AI integration](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/services/ai-integration): Quotation workflows, invoice reminders, customer enquiry support, and connected business tools.
- [Data dashboards & reporting](https://www.zizisolutions.co.za/services/analytics): Sales, expense, stock, and customer dashboards with automated reports.
